column3: who has been concerned in committing an offence
in  respect  of  whom  he  receives  information  or  a
complaint  which  he  believes  to  be  reliable  that  a
person has committed or concerned in committing
an offence under this Act; or
who is fleeing from Sri Lanka with the intention of
evading arrest or is evading arrest after committing
an offence under this Act; or
who is violating the conditions of bail, subject to
which such person has been released, being a suspect
for the commission of an offence under this Act.
